negative_findings.description: No public UJP dataset or dashboard giving the number of installed/active fiscal devices (фискални апарати) or aggregate fiscalised turnover as a downloadable time series was found. Such figures appear only narratively inside annual reports and press statements.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched UJP site sections, annual-report category and fiscalisation handbook; found rules and enforcement counts, no open statistical series.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Fiscal-device counts are the closest public proxy for the MK POS/cash-register installed base; absence forces PDF table extraction or an FOI request rather than a clean feed.

negative_findings.description: The Central Registry does not appear to publish a free, bulk, machine-readable company register or an open API for the Trade Register; structured access runs through the paid Дистрибутивен систем and fee-based per-entity services.
negative_findings.result_summary: CRM services pages and the DS/orders endpoint indicate contracted/authenticated access; no open dump located.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Building an actor map of MK banks, payment institutions and fintechs will require budget or manual per-entity work, and redistribution of registry data is licence-constrained.

negative_findings.description: Neither the State Statistical Office nor the Ministry of Finance publishes card, ATM or POS transaction statistics; those sit with the central bank (NBRSM), outside this coverage cell.
negative_findings.result_summary: SSO domains cover trade, ICT and household surveys; MoF covers fiscal/treasury. No card/ATM/POS series found in either.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This cell supplies denominators and actor identity, not payment-instrument volumes — the run must not expect core card statistics from here.

negative_findings.description: The CRM Дистрибутивен систем, the Register of Beneficial Owners and the CRM annual-accounts services were not fetched; access conditions and pricing are inferred from CRM's own service descriptions rather than observed.
negative_findings.result_summary: Login/contract signals seen in search results and CRM pages; no direct retrieval attempted or confirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Cost and licence terms materially change whether registry data can be part of an automated pipeline; must be confirmed before planning collection.

coverage_gaps.description: No register specifically enumerating licensed payment institutions and e-money issuers was located within this cell; the Central Registry lists legal entities generically and the licensing register is held by the central bank.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Cross-reference the NBRSM licence register (other cell) against CRM entity profiles by EMBS to build a joined actor table.

coverage_gaps.description: Most UJP and Central Registry material is Macedonian-only; English mirrors exist for SSO but were not systematically compared for content parity.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: For each source, record whether an /en path exists and whether it lags the Macedonian version; default collection to Macedonian.

coverage_gaps.description: SSO household budget survey (Анкета за потрошувачка на домаќинствата) and its treatment of cash vs non-cash expenditure was not examined in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up pass on 'Анкета за потрошувачка на домаќинствата' and SSO micro-data access rules for cash-usage evidence.

coverage_gaps.description: The Bureau for Public Procurement e-procurement system (e-nabavki), which would reveal bank/POS/ATM vendor contracts, falls outside this cell's four institutions but is adjacent to the Open Finance portal captured here.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assign e-nabavki.gov.mk to a procurement-focused cell or add it in a follow-up slice.

brief: In North Macedonia the non-central-bank statistical backbone splits cleanly: the State Statistical Office (ДЗС) supplies the demand-side and denominator data — monthly retail/wholesale turnover, the Eurostat-aligned ICT household and enterprise surveys covering online purchasing and e-commerce — all of it free and, crucially, machine-readable through the MAKStat PxWeb database and its API. The Ministry of Finance adds fiscal and treasury series plus the Open Finance transaction portal, which uniquely exposes public-sector spend on banking and payments vendors. The Public Revenue Office (УЈП) is the authority on fiscalisation and cash-payment registration and is the only public source touching the fiscal-device/cash-register installed base, but it publishes this narratively in annual-report PDFs rather than as data. The Central Registry (ЦРРСМ) is the decisive pointer for actor identity — trade register, beneficial owners, annual accounts — but is largely fee-based and licence-constrained, so budget or targeted per-entity lookups, not bulk scraping, should be planned. No card, ATM or POS transaction statistics live in this cell.
